title: Boundary-adjacent AtomicWriteFile
purpose: Exercise a larger but still conservative confirmed request for AtomicWriteFile so length-sensitive code sees more than the smallest dispatch case while preserving valid outer framing.
expected_behavior: The target should accept BVLC and NPDU framing, parse a confirmed request for service choice 0x07, and process a longer payload region during AtomicWriteFile validation.
constraints_preserved: BVLC type 0x81 and function 0x0A are preserved.
BVLC length 0x0012 matches the 18-byte total message size.
NPDU header is present and minimal.
APDU uses confirmed-request PDU type high nibble 0x00.
Additional payload remains wholly inside the declared frame length.
issue_safety_notes: This is a benign length-adjacent seed with self-consistent framing, not an oversized or truncated payload.
